scenarios.label: bull

bridge.net_debt_basis: broad — the 01 anchor used by 07 §5's own EV bridge (equity + 92,451 = EV)

secondary_multiples.note: the orb applies this to the same 222,587 to derive the peers COMPONENT of $278.07/share, which the blend weights at 35% — not the multiple this scenario level implies

scenarios.drivers: AWS accelerates to 35%+ revenue growth; NTM EV/EBITDA expands to 14x; blend of peers 14x ($278), DCF exit 12x ($246), SOTP bull ($221)
scenarios.source: 07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §3 (Bull/Base/Bear table) + its executed snippet, which records NTM EBITDA (consensus) $222,587M and bridges every case as (EBITDA x multiple - net debt 92,451) / 10,874 shares. The recorded `multiple` is the one the scenario LEVEL implies on that metric, at full precision. IMPLIED, not applied: the level is a four-method blend (snippet: 0.35 x peers + 0.25 x dcf + 0.40 x sotp), so no single metric x multiple builds it. The orb's own ~14.0x / ~10.5x are the PEERS-METHOD multiples — the snippet applies them to this same 222,587 to derive the peers COMPONENT ($278.07 / $206.43), which the blend then weights at 35%. They are carried as secondary cross-checks. For the BASE the two coincide: §5 computes 2,375,991 / 222,587 = 10.7x, the same implied multiple recorded here.
